newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Mapfre buys majority stake in Peru El Sol.
newsitem.headline: Mapfre buys majority stake in Peru El Sol.

text.p: Spanish insurance group Mapfre said Tuesday it was negotiating the acquisition of a majority stake in Peruvian insurance company El Sol Nacional as part of a Latin American expansion designed to make it the region's largest insurer.

"We're currently reaching final agreement in Peru that will allow us to take a majority stake in El Sol," said company President Jose Manuel Martinez, who added the Peruvian investment would total some $10 million.
Mapfre bought a majority stake in Venezuelan insurer Seguros La Seguridad in October for $35 million, Martinez said. Total investment in the region in 1996 stands at $380 million, he added.
Company executives have said foreign investments would help Mapfre reach net profit results in 1996 similar to 1995's strong 1.3 billion peseta showing.
